title: Template game
author: Somo team
description: A tiny counting game to copy when you make a new game. Not in the registry.

lines.en: How many dots? Tap the number.
Touch each dot once as you count.
lines.sw: Gusa kila nukta mara moja unapohesabu.

lines.en: Let us count together: 1, 2, 3. Now you try.
